candidates.explanation: For the LOCAL file driver, the path Transform prefixes the stored relative path with appConfig().frontendDomain instead of backendDomain. Uploaded files are served by the backend, so photo URLs in user responses (e.g. /auth/me) point at the frontend host and fail to load.

fix.description: Use backendDomain instead of frontendDomain for the local driver.
